DOCS-ONLY DESIGN TASK: write the Finder F4 (archetype ranking UI) design for apps/web. Do NOT change any code, test, fixture, workflow, compose or SQL file. The ONLY file you may create is docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md. Any other changed path is a failure. Base on current origin/main (record the SHA).

CONTEXT TO READ FIRST (cite file:line for every claim; mark anything unverified as 'Unverified'): CLAUDE.md; docs/ROADMAP.md 'Programme status — 2026-09-26' (the bullet 'The gap to the product is UI — but gated on F2c/F3 first'); docs/development/v3-finder-delivery-plan.md (F-stage table, F4 row); docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-v3-finder-f2c-f3-ranking-design.md (behavioural parity, payload fields, slice 1 vs slice 2 endpoints) and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-27-v3-finder-f2c-f3-ranking.md (what slice 1 actually delivered — then confirm against the code); docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-v3-finder-f2-archetype-ranking-design.md (archetype keys, tiers S>=88/A>=76/B>=60/C>=45/D, pop-out sliders mention); docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-product-contract.md (Finder is query/ranking owner; Svelte owns DOM/accessibility, Babylon presentation only) and docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-architecture-decision.md; docs/development/v3-browser-validation-lanes.md; apps/api/src/routers/archetypes.py (which endpoints are V3-backed today vs legacy: read the handler code, not just comments), apps/api/src/ranking/profile.py, apps/api/src/local_search.py (the search response fields), apps/api/src/models.py (response models with archetype_score/tier/primary_archetype/secondary_archetype/confidence/completeness), apps/web/src/lib/api/ (the generated facade and client.ts types already carrying archetype fields), apps/web/src/routes/explore/ and apps/web/src/lib/features/ (the current Finder/Explore UI: components, stores, how a search is issued and results rendered, how results hand off to Inspect and the map), apps/web/cypress/e2e/ (existing Finder journeys), scripts/dev/seed_cypress_v3_generation.py and scripts/dev/seed_v3_fixture_generation.py (whether the E2E/Review Lab fixtures publish system_archetype data the UI could be tested against), and scripts/v3_system_archetype_model.py (the 8 archetype keys and what each means, from _ANCHORS).

THE DOCUMENT must have these sections, written plainly (define terms a non-specialist would not know):
1. Status line: 'Design only; not implemented' with date and base SHA.
2. Goal and non-goals: F4 = the apps/web Finder gets an archetype picker, tier (S/A/B/C/D) + confidence display, primary/secondary archetype per result, and 'Best Colony Potential' headline, driven by the V3 ranking API; behavioural parity with the accepted V2 journey, not numeric parity. Non-goals: anything needing F3 slice 2 endpoints unless explicitly staged as a later increment; no legacy V2 relations; no React.
3. What exists today (inventory with file:line): the API endpoints and their backing (V3 vs legacy), the response fields, the apps/web Finder components and data flow, the typed client fields already present, what the fixtures contain, and the exact gap list.
4. API dependency map: for each UI element (picker, tier badge, confidence badge, primary/secondary, headline potential, weight sliders, per-archetype explanation, rerank) state which endpoint/field serves it today, and whether it is available now (slice 1) or needs slice 2 (`/rerank`, `/system/{id64}`, `/simulate`). Conclude which UI increments are buildable NOW against main.
5. UX design: picker (8 archetypes + 'Any'; names and one-line plain descriptions derived from the anchors), result row/card anatomy, tier badge semantics and colours (reference the existing design tokens in apps/web if any; say where they live), confidence/completeness badge wording for honest uncertainty, empty/loading/error states, keyboard and screen-reader behaviour (Svelte-owned DOM; name the ARIA roles), how selection hands off to Inspect and the Babylon results scene unchanged, and how weight sliders would appear later as a pop-out (design the slot now, wire later). Keep it consistent with the product contract's north star.
6. State and URL contract: how archetype selection, tiers and weights are represented in the Finder query state and URL (so a search is shareable), and what persists (reuse existing persistence patterns in apps/web/src/lib/persistence if present; cite).
7. Validation plan: unit tests (Vitest) for the ranking-state logic, Svelte component tests, Cypress product-E2E journeys (which fixture systems and expected tiers — state exactly what the fixture gives you or 'Unverified' and what would need adding), Review Lab scenario impact (does any existing scenario change?), visual-validation requirement per CLAUDE.md, and the OpenAPI type-drift check.
8. Implementation plan as a sequence of small PRs, each with exact files touched, tests added, and which required CI checks prove it; first PR must be buildable against main today.
9. Risks and open questions for the owner, each as a plain yes/no or choose-one question (e.g. whether F3 slice 2 should land before or after the first UI PR; whether tiers show when confidence is low; whether the archetype picker replaces or sits beside the existing economy filters).

Validation: `git diff --name-only origin/main` lists only the new spec file; the Markdown renders (headings, tables). Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 archetype ranking UI design'.
